name: my-team
description: atmux team — edit this to match your project
_comment_adr263: ADR-263 (the great simplification): a team is just a name + a list of panes. The fleet-coordination config sub-blocks (whip / report / autoMerge / orchestration / issueSync / discord-as-fleet / etc.) were deleted with their verbs. Panes are FLAT — plain Claude (or any TUI) sessions the operator drives; no roles, no briefs, no lead/planner/reviewer distinction. The optional task feed (atmux task / claim / done / issues sync) is off the critical path.
_comment_singleSession: Default false — cage isolation per ADR-018 is the safe path. Set true ONLY for non-human-driven teams or detached observer setups (declared escape hatch).

tuiCommands._comment: Per-team TUI launch aliases. If set, the prefix here replaces the built-in default for that TUI type. atmux appends --model <model> unless the prefix already has one. Example: "claude": "claude --plugin-dir=$HOME/work/journals/.sb/claude-skills"

_comment_taskSources: ADR-263 §D3 — optional git task sources for `atmux issues sync` (feed-only: poll a repo's issues/PRs → upsert as tasks, deduped on sourceId; no auto-dispatch). Add a `taskSources` array to enable. Each entry: { provider: 'github', scope: 'owner/repo', labels?: ['bug'] (GitHub AND filter), state?: 'open'|'closed'|'all', onClose?: 'done'|'leave', lane?, priority?, token? }. Token resolution: ATMUX_GITHUB_TOKEN env -> entry.token -> ~/.config/atmux/github-token. Example: "taskSources": [{ "provider": "github", "scope": "geoyws/atmux", "labels": ["bug"], "state": "open" }]
_comment_members: Flat pane list per ADR-263 §D1. Each entry is one tmux window running its `tui` (claude/opencode/shell/...). `cwd` is the working dir; `lane` is an optional task-feed affinity tag for `atmux claim --next`. `claudeAccount` (optional, per-member) isolates the Claude config dir (e.g. 'personal' → CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=$HOME/.claude-personal).
